final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count FROM income i JOIN member mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.department), shares AS (SELECT department, income_count, 1.0 * income_count / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.income_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) FROM shares s CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
